name: Hippogryph Muisek
summary: In the High Wilderness, Frayfeather hippogryphs carry spirits Uzer'i wants you to capture. Their muisek can escape unless you act quickly.

sections.title: Loyal Companions
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i trusts you with the vessel and asks you to capture another creature's spirit. Hippogryphs have long been companions to the night elves, and their spirits are loyal and steadfast. You need ten Frayfeather hippogryphs of any kind. Kill each one, then quickly shrink and capture it with the vessel to preserve its muisek. Uzer'i places them in the High Wilderness, south of the camp.

sections.title: Uzer'i's Warning
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i warns that a slain animal's muisek may escape and take the shape of a greater creature. Then its revenge would bring no peace. The work is dangerous, and Uzer'i says you have done it well again.

faq.q: Who sends you to capture hippogryphs?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i sends you to capture hippogryphs after Testing the Vessel.

faq.q: Where are the Frayfeather hippogryphs found?
aliases: where to find hippogryphs in feralas
faq.answer: Uzer'i places the Frayfeather hippogryphs in the High Wilderness, south of the camp.

faq.q: Why does Witch Doctor Uzer'i want hippogryph spirits?
faq.answer: Hippogryphs are old companions of the night elves, and Uzer'i says their spirits are loyal and steadfast. He wants their muisek preserved.
Kill a Frayfeather hippogryph, then quickly shrink and capture it with the muisek vessel. Ten are wanted, of any kind.

faq.q: What step comes before this in the chain?
faq.answer: Testing the Vessel comes before this. There, you proved trustworthy and able to use the muisek vessel.
